scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic Gegenbauer coefficient proof and Schoenberg characterization; low-degree S² preservation relies on a published Legendre Bernstein bound. The standalone rational checker supplies finite corroboration, not a proof of unrestricted quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The sharp iff degree frontier is proved only for S². In higher dimensions only the obstruction for n≥d+2 is proved; no sufficiency for smaller n or strict positive-definiteness is claimed. Only ordinary affine Bernstein sampling, not geodesic circle Bernstein operators, is treated.
title: A sharp degree frontier for affine Bernstein approximation of spherical positive-definite kernels
